title: B2B SaaS product design for complex operational workflows
description: Designing for multi-module, operational B2B platforms — the kind of workflow complexity found in contact-center and cloud-operations software.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §1 — Capacidades mais bem sustentadas

title: Onboarding / FTUX strategy and guided tutorials
description: Auditing onboarding approaches across modules and defining a reusable guided-tutorial model (welcome modal, progressive contextual tips, persistent help panel, re-activation of completed tutorials).
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §1–§2 — FTUX e onboarding

title: Design systems at scale — tokens, components, governance
description: Evolving tokens, components, variants, layouts, typography, and color; documenting implementation requirements, testing, and Jira-linked handoff; connecting systemic work to product delivery rather than only visual maintenance.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §1–§2 — Design System e qualidade

title: UX/UI quality review and accessibility applied to states and interactions
description: Reviewing keyboard focus, modal semantics, feedback, disabled states, breadcrumbs, and navigation consistency.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §2 — Design System e qualidade

title: Discovery with SMEs, cross-functional alignment, and dependency management
description: Clarifying requirements and terminology with stakeholders and subject-matter experts; turning broad initiatives into phases, epics, stories, dependencies, and explicit decisions; making risks, open questions, and ownership visible.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §2 — Product strategy e definição de escopo

title: Prototyping, documentation, and implementation-ready handoff
description: Producing prototypes, component pages, specifications, Jira structures, and handoff material; incorporating development feedback and QA findings into the next iteration.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §2 — Colaboração e entrega

title: AI-assisted design workflows and agentic-process exploration
description: Producing specifications with an AI-assisted design flow and specifying an agentic workflow for Figma documentation and Jira management — treating feasibility, human review, and safety as explicit requirements, without claiming unmeasured autonomy or productivity gains.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §1–§2 — AI e operações de design

title: Information architecture and workflow design
description: Defining taxonomies, onboarding priorities, navigation, and terminology; designing interactions with multi-select, contextual menus, drawers, loading states, and progressive disclosure.
source: Inventário de Conteúdo §2 — Arquitetura da informação e workflows
